name: Venture Home
old_description: We put solar panels, battery storage, and EV charging together in one system, tailored to your lifestyle.
about:
Venture Home, headquartered in Hudson, Massachusetts, has been designing and installing whole-home solar energy systems since 2014. The company operates across the Northeast with fully in-house design, installation, and service teams, employing hundreds of dedicated staff.

The firm integrates solar panels, battery storage, EV chargers, smart electrical panels, and microinverters into unified systems managed through a mobile app. To date, it has installed more than 15,000 systems for residential customers, handling everything from initial design and permitting to final commissioning and ongoing maintenance.

Venture Home serves homeowners in Connecticut, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, and Rhode Island. Its customers are typically residential property owners seeking to reduce electricity costs, gain backup power during outages, and manage energy consumption through smart controls.

The company differentiates itself with a no-pressure sales approach, a 25-year workmanship warranty, and certifications including Tesla Premier Certified Installer, Enphase Gold Installer, and NABCEP credentials. Its all-in-one model aims to provide predictable energy costs and automatic energy management without relying on utility grids.
